reference_preconditions: Level 2, train running in a mode such as FS, OS, SR, LS or AD, radio session with the RBC established. Position report parameters are stored so that position reports are sent periodically (in time or distance). Linking information is stored on-board that contains BG1 and a group further ahead, but does not contain BG3; linking consistency is checked.

reference_checks.action: The train passes BG1, a balise group marked as linked and contained in the stored linking information; the next position report is sent.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU reports its position to the RBC with BG1 as the LRBG (reference balise group).
reference_checks.channel_note: BTM: balise group message with Q_LINK=1 and packet 255; RTM: message 136 Train Position Report with packet 0, NID_LRBG = BG1; JRU: TELEGRAM FROM BALISE (NID_MESSAGE_JRU=6), MESSAGE TO RBC (NID_MESSAGE_JRU=10). BG1 placed a few metres before the D_CYCLOC/T_CYCLOC period.

basis.text: Referenced as BG1. The balise is … contained in the previously received … One Balise Group message (Q_LINK=1) … linking information … containing packet 255 is received … SA-DATA.Request with Euroradio Message … "Train Position Report" (NID_MESSAGE=136) O RTM Referring to BG1

reference_checks.action: After BG1, the train passes BG2, a balise group marked as unlinked; the next periodic position report is sent.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU still reports BG1 as the LRBG; the unlinked BG2 is not used as reference in the position report.
reference_checks.channel_note: BTM: balise group message with Q_LINK=0 and packet 255, placed at BG1 + position report period; RTM: message 136 with packet 0, NID_LRBG = BG1; JRU: NID_MESSAGE_JRU=6 and 10.

basis.text: Referenced as BG2 … One Balise Group message (Q_LINK=0) … The balise group message is unlinked. … containing packet 255 is received … SA-DATA.Request with Euroradio Message … "Train Position Report" (NID_MESSAGE=136) O RTM Referring to BG1

reference_checks.action: The train then passes BG3, a balise group marked as linked but not contained in the stored linking information (linking consistency is checked); the next periodic position report is sent.
reference_checks.expected: The OBU still reports BG1 as the LRBG; BG3 is not used as reference in the position report.
reference_checks.channel_note: BTM: balise group message with Q_LINK=1 and packet 255, placed at BG1 + 2x position report period; RTM: message 136 with packet 0, NID_LRBG = BG1; JRU: NID_MESSAGE_JRU=6 and 10.

basis.text: Referenced as BG3 … The balise is not contained in the … One Balise Group message (Q_LINK=1) … previously received linking information … containing packet 255 is received … SA-DATA.Request with Euroradio Message … "Train Position Report" (NID_MESSAGE=136) O RTM Referring to BG1

support_passages.text: 3.6.2.2.2 For the LRBG the following requirements have to be met: a) The on-board equipment shall use as a reference for reporting the train position to the RBC the last passed LRBG compliant balise group that fulfils the conditions of the clause 3.6.5.1.8. This balise group is termed as LRBGONB in the following. Only • balise groups marked as linked and contained in the previously received linking information, if linking consistency is checked on-board or • balise groups not marked as unlinked, if linking consistency was not checked when such a balise group was passed shall be regarded as LRBG compliant balise groups.
3.6.5.1.3 Note: A balise group marked as unlinked is never used for position reporting to the RBC, since its location, or the balise group itself, may not be known to the RBC.

3.6.5.1.8 After an LRBG compliant balise group is passed, the ERTMS/ETCS on-board equipment shall be allowed to report the train position with this balise group as reference only once the content of the message from this balise group and the content of the messages from all the previous LRBG compliant balise groups (if any) have been taken into account.

7.5.1.114 Q_LINK Name Link Qualifier Description This qualifier is used to mark a balise group as linked or unlinked. Length of variable Minimum Value Maximum Value Resolution/formula 1 bit Special/Reserved Values 0 Unlinked 1 Linked

3.4.4.2.1.1 "Linking consistency is checked" shall be interpreted as when: a) linking information is stored on-board, AND b) depending on the mode the linking consistency check is active, AND c) the supervision of the expectation window of the furthest announced balise group has not yet been stopped (see 3.4.4.4.6).

3.6.5.1.5 For the position report parameters requested by the RBC the following possibilities shall be available, individually or in combination a) Periodically in time. b) Periodically in space. c) When the max safe front end or min safe rear end of the train has passed a specified location. d) At every passage of an LRBG compliant balise group (see 3.6.2.2.2 a)).

reference_note: One test case (3060200/TC2), all steps tagged 3.6.2.2.2. Kept 3 checks (steps 1+3, 5+7, 9+11). Dropped 6 steps (2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12): JRU recordings of the received telegram and of the sent position report, channel duplicates of the kept outcomes (clause 3.6.2.2.2). Requirement text: it says compliance 'depends on' linked/unlinked marking and on whether linking consistency is checked but does not state the rule itself (only groups marked linked AND contained in the linking information when linking is checked; groups not marked unlinked otherwise), so the BG2/BG3 outcomes need the document. It also omits the condition of 3.6.5.1.8 (the group may be used as reference only once its message and those of all previous LRBG compliant groups have been taken into account); not exercised by the test case.
